raw_text: Read [README.md](README.md) and [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md). Stack: C++ (MinGW), Go, TypeScript + React. Build: `npm run build` (or individual `npm run build:interceptor|native-host|extension`). Test: `npm run test`. Privacy-focused/local-first: data stays local; external API calls only when necessary (Gmail API for sending). Cost-conscious; prefer solutions that don't require paid services. TypeScript strict mode required. Keep related things together; avoid excessive file splitting and bloat. Use React Bootstrap, Radix UI, or similar. Avoid utility-first CSS: No Tailwind. Prefer semantic markup. Prepare translations using message catalogs or i18n libraries.
